headline: AI Stock Correction Sparks Debate Over Tech Spending and Market Impact
summary: A sharp correction in artificial intelligence stocks reflects growing concerns over regulatory pressures, capital costs, and profitability, prompting warnings from analysts.
why: High valuations in the technology sector make broader equity markets vulnerable to shifts in sentiment regarding artificial intelligence infrastructure spending.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: A drop in high-valuation AI stocks weighs heavily on technology-heavy equity indexes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Concerns over regulatory risks and capital costs in artificial intelligence triggered a sell-off in technology equities.
